import inspect
import pytest
from mcp.server.mcpserver import MCPServer
from mcp.server.mcpserver.context import Context
from mcp.server.mcpserver.limits import LimitPolicy, Quota, RateLimit


def _get_client_class():
    for module_path in ("mcp", "mcp.client", "mcp.server.mcpserver", "mcp.server.fastmcp"):
        try:
            mod = __import__(module_path, fromlist=["Client"])
            if hasattr(mod, "Client"):
                return getattr(mod, "Client")
        except ImportError:
            pass
    return None


@pytest.mark.anyio
async def test_list_tools_unlimited_tool_has_none_meta():
    server = MCPServer("test")
    server.add_tool(lambda: "ok", name="unlimited")
    tools = await server.list_tools()
    assert tools[0].meta is None

    server.add_tool(lambda: "ok", name="unlimited", meta={"author": "bob"})
    tools = await server.list_tools()
    assert tools[0].meta == {"author": "bob"}

@pytest.mark.anyio
async def test_remaining_calls_inside_first_call_is_max_calls():
    server = MCPServer("test")
    seen = []

    def my_tool(ctx: Context) -> str:
        seen.append(ctx.remaining_calls("my_tool"))
        return "ok"

    server.add_tool(my_tool, name="my_tool", limits=LimitPolicy(quota=Quota(max_calls=3)))
    ctx = Context(mcp_server=server)
    await server.call_tool("my_tool", {}, ctx)
    assert seen == [3]


@pytest.mark.anyio
async def test_remaining_calls_inside_second_call_decrements():
    server = MCPServer("test")
    seen = []

    def my_tool(ctx: Context) -> str:
        seen.append(ctx.remaining_calls("my_tool"))
        return "ok"

    server.add_tool(my_tool, name="my_tool", limits=LimitPolicy(quota=Quota(max_calls=3)))
    ctx = Context(mcp_server=server)
    await server.call_tool("my_tool", {}, ctx)
    await server.call_tool("my_tool", {}, ctx)
    assert seen == [3, 2]




@pytest.mark.anyio
async def test_context_can_check_limits_of_another_tool():
    server = MCPServer("test")
    policy_b = LimitPolicy(quota=Quota(max_calls=7))
    server.add_tool(lambda: "b", name="tool_b", limits=policy_b)
    server.add_tool(lambda ctx: str(ctx.tool_limits("tool_b")), name="tool_a")
    ctx = Context(mcp_server=server)
    assert ctx.tool_limits("tool_b") == policy_b
